SELECT 
    o.opsregistry,
    o.emerglevel,
    o.opsstatus,
    o.resp_phase,
    ce.safety_ranking,
    ce.secincidentcount,
    hr.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'medical' as medical_staff,
    d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected' as affected_pop,
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected' AS numeric) > 0 
        THEN (CAST(hr.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'medical' AS numeric) / CAST(d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected' AS numeric)) * 1000

JOIN disasterevents d ON hr.hrdistref = d.distregistry
WHERE o.opsstatus = 'Active'
  AND (ce.safety_ranking = 'High Risk' OR ce.secincidentcount > 5)
ORDER BY medical_staff_ratio ASC;

  AND (CAST(hr.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'medical' AS numeric) / CAST(d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected' AS numeric)) * 1000 < 0.5;

-- Count with OR condition
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.opsregistry)
FROM operations o
JOIN coordinationandevaluation ce ON o.opsregistry = ce.coordopsref
JOIN humanresources hr ON o.opsregistry = hr.hr_ops_ref
JOIN disasterevents d ON hr.hrdistref = d.distregistry
WHERE (ce.safety_ranking = 'High Risk' OR ce.secincidentcount > 5)
  AND CAST(hr.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'medical' AS numeric) > 0
  AND CAST(d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected' AS numeric) > 0
  AND (CAST(hr.staffing_details->'staff_counts'->>'medical' AS numeric) / CAST(d.impact_summary->'population_impact'->>'affected' AS numeric)) * 1000 < 0.5;
